questions.question: Find the odd one out: Apple, Mango, Potato, Banana
questions.explanation: Apple, mango and banana are fruits. Potato is a vegetable.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Dog, Cat, Sparrow, Cow
questions.explanation: Dog, cat and cow are mammals. Sparrow is a bird.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Mercury, Venus, Moon, Mars
questions.explanation: Mercury, Venus and Mars are planets. The Moon is a natural satellite.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Rose, Lily, Jasmine, Mango
questions.explanation: Rose, lily and jasmine are flowers. Mango is a fruit.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Pen, Pencil, Eraser, Chalk
questions.explanation: Pen, pencil and chalk are used to write. An eraser is used to remove writing.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Red, Blue, Green, Square
questions.explanation: Red, blue and green are colours. Square is a shape.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Java, Python, HTML, Windows
questions.explanation: Java, Python and HTML are languages used to write software or web pages. Windows is an operating system.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Triangle, Square, Cube, Circle
questions.explanation: Triangle, square and circle are flat (2D) shapes. A cube is a solid (3D) shape.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Delhi
questions.explanation: Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata are coastal port cities. Delhi is an inland city.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Kilometre, Litre, Metre, Centimetre
questions.explanation: Kilometre, metre and centimetre are units of length. The litre is a unit of volume.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Eagle, Parrot, Bat, Crow
questions.explanation: Eagle, parrot and crow are birds. A bat is a flying mammal.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Iron, Copper, Gold, Diamond
questions.explanation: Iron, copper and gold are metals. Diamond is a form of carbon, a non-metal.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Whale, Shark, Dolphin, Seal
questions.explanation: Whale, dolphin and seal are mammals. Shark is a fish.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Wheat, Rice, Maize, Cotton
questions.explanation: Wheat, rice and maize are cereal food crops. Cotton is a fibre crop.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Tenor, Bass, Soprano, Violin
questions.explanation: Tenor, bass and soprano are types of singing voice. The violin is a musical instrument.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Sitar, Veena, Tabla, Guitar
questions.explanation: Sitar, veena and guitar are string instruments. The tabla is a percussion instrument.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Hydrogen, Oxygen, Water, Nitrogen
questions.explanation: Hydrogen, oxygen and nitrogen are elements. Water is a compound.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Kilogram, Metre, Second, Newton
questions.explanation: Kilogram, metre and second are base units of the SI system. Newton is a derived unit (kg·m/s²).

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Voltmeter, Ammeter, Thermometer, Galvanometer
questions.explanation: Voltmeter, ammeter and galvanometer are used in electrical circuits. A thermometer measures temperature.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Ludo, Chess, Carrom, Cricket
questions.explanation: Ludo, chess and carrom are indoor board games. Cricket is an outdoor field game.
